NoSQLServer v0.48 validation
============================

Focus
-----
Single-row INSERT publication now appends one native CsvStream record rather
than rewriting the complete delimited table.

Implementation
--------------
- DelimitedTableStorage~appendRow opens native .CsvStream with WRITE APPEND.
- csvLineOut performs existing delimiter/qualifier escaping and calls LINEOUT.
- FileDatabaseTable~insert validates first, then appends only the new row.
- Multi-row INSERT deliberately retains whole-file publication so a single SQL
  statement cannot become partially visible if an append fails midway.
- UPDATE and DELETE remain rewrite-based pending an explicit fixed-record /
  tombstone storage contract.

Correctness
-----------
- simple append: PASS
- embedded comma quoting: PASS
- embedded quote escaping: PASS
- multi-row INSERT compatibility: PASS
- all historical SQL/FK/event/optimizer gates: PASS
- Claude torture: 12/12 PASS
- Grok hell v1: 24/25 PASS, 0 wrong results
- Grok hell v2: 14/30 PASS, 0 wrong results

Performance note
----------------
At 50-row microbenchmark scale, v0.47 and v0.48 are both around 1.1 seconds for
50 separate SQL INSERT statements. This shows that after eliminating full data
file rewrite, the next dominant cost is existing-row scanning for constraints
and per-mutation journal/catalog work. The user's 5,000-row workload should be
rerun against v0.48, but further write scaling will require indexed constraint
validation rather than repeated table scans.
